description: This file defines a CooldownCache class that manages model cooldown logic, including adding cooldowns, retrieving active cooldowns, and calculating minimum cooldowns, utilizing caching mechanisms and masking sensitive data.

classes.name: CooldownCache
classes.description: Manages model cooldowns, including adding, retrieving, and calculating minimum cooldown times, with support for asynchronous operations and cache integration.

classes.name: CooldownCacheValue
classes.description: TypedDict representing the data stored for each cooldown, including exception info, status, timestamp, and cooldown duration.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the CooldownCache with a cache instance and default cooldown time.

methods.name: _common_add_cooldown_logic
methods.description: Internal method to prepare cooldown data and generate cache key.

methods.name: add_deployment_to_cooldown
methods.description: Adds a cooldown entry for a specific model deployment, with optional dynamic cooldown time.

methods.name: get_cooldown_cache_key
methods.description: Generates a cache key for a given model ID, cached with lru_cache.

methods.name: async_get_active_cooldowns
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves active cooldowns for a list of model IDs.

methods.name: get_active_cooldowns
methods.description: Synchronously retrieves active cooldowns for a list of model IDs.

methods.name: get_min_cooldown
methods.description: Calculates the minimum cooldown time among a group of model IDs.
